description: `memo(Component, arePropsEqual?)` returns a component that skips re-rendering when its props are shallowly equal to the previous render.
Each prop is compared with `Object.is`. Primitives compare by value, objects, arrays and functions by **reference**.
Passing the same object/function reference across renders. Inline `{}`, `[]` and `() => {}` in JSX are new references every render.
Optional second argument of `memo`: `(prevProps, nextProps) => boolean`. Return `true` to skip the render. Rarely needed and easy to get wrong.
